steps: Add an H2 "Send clinic closure alerts from Outlook" under "How it works".
Answer the closure case in the first two sentences under it.
Add the three set-up steps from the shared Outlook inbox as a numbered list.
draft:
How do we text staff when the clinic closes early?
Write the closure notice in your shared Outlook inbox and send it to the staff group address; every phone gets it as a normal text, and replies come back to the same inbox. No one installs an app. Set up the group once, then each alert takes a minute to send. [Check the per-message price before publishing.]
